scope: Not part of the Western Cape Sprint 5 pattern test. These pins do not feed its predictions, scoring, thresholds or the arrest-gap comparison (tools/checked_signals.py: pattern_test_pins). Crime & Security stream, as deaths police are dealing with, not as confirmed killings. From the 23 Oct 2026 Louis Trichardt, Polokwane and Thohoyandou targeted sweep; other candidates from that sweep are not in this file.
rules: Standalone signals: no case, entity or map-line links. Cause of death unknown in both: every title and summary says so and gives the police status the sources report (an inquest docket for Madombidzha; 'investigating' for Mashawana, where the case type is not reported). Family and resident beliefs about foul play or injuries are given as theirs, never as findings. Victims are not named; residents' guesses about who the Mashawana men were are not repeated. Incident date is the date found, kept apart from the report date. Pin = the place the source gives; 'approx.' in the title. Both pins are checked in every three-day collection run for police confirmation, post-mortem results, identification, a case change or an arrest, and amended as a new pin version with its sources when that happens (owner decision of 23 Oct 2026). Every fact-base quote matched word for word against the saved source text.
review_status: Approved by the owner on 23 Oct 2026 (voice call, about 16:53 SAST); one explicit version-1 approval record per pin in docs/approvals/pins (reference vhembe-unresolved-deaths-approval-2026-10-23).

signals.title: Madombidzha village, Tshilwavhusiku police area (approx.): man, 53, found dead in his shack; cause unknown, inquest opened, 1 Oct
signals.content: Cause of death unknown. Police opened an inquest, not a murder case. A 53-year-old man who lived alone was found dead, his body partly decomposed, in a shack at his home in Madombidzha village, about 13 km south-west of Louis Trichardt, on 1 October. A friend who went to check on him found him; he had last been seen alive on 26 September (his aunt, via Limpopo Mirror, 8 October). Vhembe police spokesperson Captain Vuledzani Dathi said Tshilwavhusiku police opened an inquest docket. The family suspects foul play and believes he may have been killed elsewhere and his body left in the shack; that is the family's belief, not a police finding. No cause of death, post-mortem result, murder case or arrest has been reported. When he died is not known, and it may have been before 1 October. The man is not named here. One account, repeated: Review Online (19 October) carries the same reporting. The pin is approximate (village level). This pin is checked in every three-day collection run and will be updated if police confirm a cause of death or open a case.

signals.title: Mashawana mountain, Thohoyandou police area (approx.): two unidentified men found dead; cause unknown, police investigating, 4 Oct
signals.content: Cause of death unknown. Police are investigating; the report does not say whether an inquest or a murder case was opened. A cattle herder found the bodies of two unidentified men lying next to each other in a remote part of Mashawana mountain at about 13:30 on Sunday 4 October, with pots, cups, bedding and other utensils nearby (Limpopo Mirror, 8 October). A resident said the bodies were badly decomposed and showed no injuries; that is a resident's account, not a post-mortem finding. Vhembe police spokesperson Captain Vuledzani Dathi confirmed that Thohoyandou police are investigating. The men have not been identified, and residents' guesses about who they were are not repeated here. One report. The pin is approximate: the mountain is not on the map, so the pin is the Dzwerani village point, one of the two communities the report names. This pin is checked in every three-day collection run and will be updated if police confirm a cause of death, identify the men or open a case.

checked.incident: Found at about 13:30 on Sun 4 Oct 2026 by a cattle herder; when the men died is not known (Limpopo Mirror). Cause of death unknown; Thohoyandou police are investigating (police, via Limpopo Mirror).
checked.location: A remote mountainous part of Mashawana mountain; the report names the communities of Mashawana and Dzwerani, Thulamela municipality, and Thohoyandou police are investigating. The mountain is not in the gazetteer or OpenStreetMap, so the pin is the Dzwerani village point from GeoNames. That point falls just inside the Vuwani precinct outline, about 3.3 km from the Thohoyandou precinct edge, so the scene is probably a few kilometres from the pin. Approximate, village level (about 6 km).
